shared_or_similar_visual_information: Filled circular marker on a curve
mathematical_meanings: Left image: Highlights and locates a designated position on a geometric curve. Right image: Highlights and locates a designated position on a function curve.
Rationales: Only the general position-marking role is compared; the left point is not interpreted as a domain endpoint, and although the right point is at a trough, the filled marker itself still serves to locate it.
